mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, goods_id, seller_account, buyer_account, price, status, create_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{goodsId}, #{sellerAccount}, #{buyerAccount}, #{price}, #{status}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE buyer_account = #{buyerAccount} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE seller_account = #{sellerAccount} ORDER BY create_time DESC
